notes.title: 🔔 One Month Until B.E.S.T's Full Release… Or Not?
notes.notes: [h2]Hey B.E.S.T.I.E.S ![/h2][p][/p][p]Here we are: 30 days to go before the official release of [b]B.E.S.T[/b] on [b]August 29, 2025[/b]. That’s huge for us — more than two years of development, passion, struggles, and incredible moments with all of you.[/p][p]But today, we want to take a moment to talk to you [b]openly and honestly[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/c497ef68e185e50f6d1b9c8b1ff4ebb7de801932.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]📊 Development Status[/h3][p][/p][p]Episode 5 is nearly done. We're wrapping up the final scene, translations are in progress, and we're polishing the last technical adjustments.[/p][p]We’re also working hard on:[/p][list][*][p]The next episode,[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Deck performance,[/p][/*][*][p]Save file stability for returning players.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]⚠️ The Challenges We’re Facing[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/d9dc2e533224cadef13d9960198a260104bbb515.png"][/img][/p][p]Lately, our biggest challenge hasn’t been technical… but [b]political[/b].[/p][p]A wave of censorship has started affecting many narrative games — especially those with adult content, even when it’s mild or story-driven.[/p][p]We’ve received multiple warning signs: reduced visibility, geo-blocking in certain countries, even sudden bans — often with [b]no clear explanation[/b] from the platforms.[/p][p]And yet, [b]B.E.S.T is far from being a porn game[/b]. It’s a story. A universe. Complex characters. A mix of romance, strategy, and social dynamics.[/p][p]But nowadays, [b]that alone is enough to trigger problems[/b], especially when the rules are vague… or just plain unclear.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧩 So What Happens Next?[/h3][p][/p][p]We’re doing everything we can to keep [b]B.E.S.T[/b] available [b]in the form you know and love — without compromise[/b].[/p][p]But let’s be honest: 🎭 The future is a bit uncertain.[/p][p]We’re exploring different options — but one thing is clear: [b]we’re not giving up[/b].[/p][p]B.E.S.T wasn’t supposed to go beyond this arc. It was a one-shot, originally. But your support, the characters, the world, and everything we’ve built together made us want to go [b]further[/b]. Deeper. Bigger.[/p][p]We’ve seen the questions on the forums about a sequel or a “Season 2.”[/p][p]Let’s clear a few things up:[/p][list][*][p]The [b]price of the game will not change[/b]. This was an Early Access project shaped by your feedback — and we’re staying true to that.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]future is uncertain[/b]. A month before launch, we don’t even know if we’ll be able to release the full version [b]without interference[/b]. So making long-term plans is risky.[/p][/*][/list][p]BUT — we’ve talked to players about what some would call a “Season 2.”[/p][p]We’re not fond of that term. If the B.E.S.T is over, then the game is over. Instead, we think in terms of [b]story arcs[/b].[/p][p]If we decide to continue the story — a new chapter, a new challenge — it would be [b]in a new, upgraded engine[/b], with proper 4K support, better features, and all the lessons learned from this development.[/p][p]We won’t be making paid DLC for B.E.S.T. It doesn’t make sense right now, especially with the risks we’re facing.[/p][p]Again: [b]we have no idea what’s coming[/b]. So for now, we’re focused on one thing only — releasing the full version.[/p][p]The rest — including a possible Episode 6 — will depend entirely on [b]how well the release goes[/b], and what [b]the platform climate[/b] looks like afterward.[/p][p]We’re even considering a [b]“censored” version for general audiences[/b], just to be safe…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/0c6964f98b80b2be510ea2785ab61fcb9dfe0aee.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]💬 What You Can Do[/h3][p][/p][p]If you enjoy the game — if you’ve liked the story, the characters, or just the general vibe — [b]your support matters now more than ever[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Leaving a review on [b]Steam[/b], even a short one, helps a lot. We're currently at [b]79% positive[/b], and we’re just one percent away from reaching "Very Positive" — a huge milestone before launch.[/p][/*][*][p]Join us on [b]Discord[/b] and share your thoughts about what you want to see next — or how you think we should handle this situation.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]❤️ Thank You[/h3][p][/p][p]Thank you for being here. Thank you for your patience. Thank you for your feedback and trust.[/p][p]We’ve had doubts. We’ve struggled. But we’ve never stopped wanting to [b]finish this game the way it deserves[/b] to be finished.[/p][p]We’ll see you on [b]August 29[/b]. Until then, take care — and keep being the BEST 🏆[/p][p]— The Dolydev Team[/p]

notes.title: DevLog 2 : Episode 2 Extended Version
notes.notes:
Hello to all our B.E.S.T players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/a9c4c57738d62a5a28eb357685908264c975a313.png[/img]

Today, a little update on the progress of the update planned to extend episode 2 with the old part 1 of episode 3! After receiving your comments on this part which seemed problematic to us, we decided to change the way the episodes were divided to end the day with episode 2 and move on to a new day with episode 3!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/2fec6fe61350d41c41c1366678bc0f9dddcb3687.png[/img]

So the “advance” that we had on episode 3 helps us with that and we are in the process of finishing this update with a “lewd” scene and a “romantic” scene. Once these two scenes are finished we can move on to the final translations to be done, check that everything is working as it should and deliver this update to you to finally move on to episode 3 which will be quite important in terms of gameplay and story. !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/3b8086a5698c2261fc30329590620f582ceab713.png[/img]

Today again there are bank and accounting meetings and this end of the week will therefore be devoted to these last two scenes to be finished, to the animations to be carried out and the last renderings to be made.

See you soon for, I hope, the update goes online!

Dolyla

notes.title: 4 days before release !
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Well, it's been a year since we started the game, and it's finally happening this week...
The release!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/6988de0b00c5471c0840d92d55ac1aabfba1820a.png[/img]

In 4 days, you'll be able to try out our game and let us know what you think and, hopefully, help us improve it!

Since the holidays, we haven't made much progress on Episode 3 because we've taken on a new project: translations!
Currently, we're working with translators on 4 new languages to include (not all of them will be ready for the release...):

    Italian
    Spanish (LATAM)
    Russian
    Chinese (Traditional and Simplified)

We'll create posts in the discussion space so you can tell us what you think about the translation and suggest improvements!

We're counting on you to tell us what you like or don't like, so don't hesitate!

Dolyla
